listing.name: Armored Core: Master of Arena / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Build and play Armored Core: Master of Arena on Windows or Linux with your own matching USA two-disc set and retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. You can also use a separately prepared upstream copy.

steps.title: Use the exact original files
steps.instruction: Use your own Armored Core: Master of Arena (USA) two-disc set (SLUS-01030, SLUS-01081), each disc with its single data track, and your own retail SCPH-1001 BIOS.

steps.title: Set up the managed Windows or Linux player
steps.instruction: In Portcove, select the complete matching CHD for every disc in order, and the BIOS. Keep the original files in place. Portcove builds the player with its registered toolchain. Choose the disc when you choose Play. To change discs, use the game's own disc change if it offers one, or quit and choose Play with the next disc.

steps.title: Prepare a separate Mac copy
steps.instruction: Choose the official Mac ZIP from the upstream releases: -macos-x64.zip for Intel or -macos-arm64.zip for Apple silicon, and extract it. Put Xcode Command Line Tools, CMake, Ninja and Python 3 on PATH. The Mac setup host and bundled generators require macOS 11 or newer.

steps.title: Build and add the completed Mac player
steps.instruction: Run Armored_Core_Master_of_Arena from the kit folder, assign every disc in Disc Selection and choose Generate & rebuild. In Portcove, select build-release/Armored_Core_Master_of_Arena as the player and build-release as its start folder.

warnings: Portcove checks each disc's data track and track count. Keep every disc intact.
Mac setup, replacement and backups belong to you and the upstream kit. Native setup, gameplay and populated-save behavior remain unverified.

references.title: Keep the original files and your data
references.instruction: Keep your discs and BIOS separately. For a Mac copy, close the game and back up the complete working folder and its saves, settings and installed mods before replacing the kit.

source_requirements.label: Armored Core: Master of Arena (USA) two-disc set

presentation.manual_preparation: Provide your own single-track CHDs for SLUS-01030, SLUS-01081 in disc order and retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. Portcove verifies each disc's data track and builds a private player with its registered toolchain, retaining its declared saves, settings and installed mods. Choose the disc when you choose Play. To change discs, use the game's own disc change if it offers one, or quit and choose Play again with the next disc. Bundled mods belong to the runtime version. Windows and Linux package and source fit were statically inspected. Native build, disc switching, gameplay and save compatibility remain unobserved.
